name: Ship gate: LAN door for `powos self push --ship` (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: authenticated HTTP endpoint (port 7433, LAN) that lets a device which pushed a sha to origin ask the Mac to ship it: tools/phone/ship-gate.py calls `ship.sh request --sha` (same .req, same 'must be on origin' rule) and never ships by itself. Bearer secret from ~/.config/powos/ship-gate.secret (0600, provisioned out of band, never in git)
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one idle python3 http.server (stdlib, ~15 MB), request bodies capped at 8 KB, each request runs ship.sh request (a git fetch) with a 60 s timeout
